1. Why 10s Pot Averaging & 8h Bath Assays Fail 500kA Smelters
• Alumina Starvation (<1.4%) & 28V Anode-Effect PFC Explosion:
960°C molten cryolite dissolves any chemical probe. Legacy 10s low-pass
filters discard the 32Hz bubble-release voltage flicker (24.5mV) 38s
before an Anode Effect spikes voltage to 28V and emits CF4 (6,630x CO2)
& C2F6 (11,100x CO2), wrecking EU CBAM & ASI green-aluminum status.
• 0.042Hz MHD Metal-Pad Roll Wave & Side-Ledge Tap-Out:
500kA J×B Lorentz forces excite rotating waves in the liquid aluminum
pad (4.2cm ACD), shorting 40,000A through Anode-A07, melting the
frozen cryolite side-ledge to 7.2cm and risking a $4.2M shell tap-out.
